explication: TimeCapsuleSMB installs and manages a Samba server on Apple Time Capsule devices so newer Macs can use their disks over SMB, including for Time Machine. The main workflow is to discover and configure a device, enable SSH, deploy Samba, and run a checkup; users can also activate, repair, flash a boot hook, maintain, or uninstall the installation. The repository contains both a macOS GUI and a Python CLI/API backed by shared device operations. Relationships among unsampled operation implementations are omitted; README-documented workflows and indexed imports support the links shown.
